variants.name: implement-spec
variants.reason: Requires a verified ready integration PR, tracks ownership and Project progress, and keeps PRD and tickets non-terminal until the final PR is merged.

variants.name: implement
variants.reason: Adds isolated implementation and independent review with standalone, stack, and integration delivery plus repository-configured ownership and Project progress.

variants.name: ask-matt
variants.reason: Routes linear chains to stacked implementation and PRD forks/joins with a final merge to integration delivery.

variants.name: to-tickets
variants.reason: Preserves authoritative issue blockers and delivery topology, requires native GitHub sub-issues, and inherits parent ownership with verified Project tracking.

variants.name: shadcn-dream
variants.reason: Adds shadcn-dream style in two cases: migrating a default shadcn project (migrate.md) and the adopt pass on every file the shadcn CLI writes (cva 1.0.0-beta.12 and cn via lib/cva, exported Props interfaces, export at declaration, no React namespace import, radix-ui via migrate radix, dream global CSS base layer), verified by scripts/dream-audit.mjs.

variants.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
variants.reason: Discovers existing GitHub Projects and scaffolds repository ownership, Status mapping, native workflow, and final-PR completion policy while preserving other trackers and domain setup.

variants.name: to-spec
variants.reason: Assigns new PRDs to the driving developer, preserves existing issue identity and ownership, and verifies configured Project membership and initial Status.
